name: Narimiya Takashi
source:
Narimiya assits Haru with his given task, by collecting additional intelligence based on the infromation Haru provides him. 

He is very calm, neutral and diplomatic. He doesn't call out on others if they make a mistake, and maintains his cold blood in all situations, placing the mission above anything else.
